dataset: Mainland LiDAR2024, published Portugal3D classified point-cloud preview
accuracy_note: Estimated racing-profile uncertainty includes mapped-road registration and interpolation. Preview coordinates are quantized0.01m, not evidence of centimetre survey accuracy.
acquisition: April2024, per selected source-tile filenames; preview headers record processing in2026, not a new flight.
attribution: Direcao-Geral do Territorio, mainland LiDAR. Class2selection,1m representative decimation and ground interpolation modified by Formula Forge.
selection: Actual class-2 observation closest to each1m EPSG3763 bin center. No averaged/invented point heights.

decoding.method: Official public Portugal3D viewer WASM point decoder; source SDK is not redistributed. Class2selected directly from decoded classification array, XYZ retained before any interpolation.
decoding.tree_validation: All decoded coordinates were checked against source quadtree node bounds; childorderSW,NW,SE,NE.
